How to Make Buttermilk (2-ingredient Milk Kefir recipe)
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Wednesday, September 25, 2019 - 10:05am

Ingredients




Buttermilk culture (C21), 4 packets
https://amzn.to/2muO0LU
1 gallon Pasteurized Milk
dry milk
https://amzn.to/2l27Bmo

Preparation

1 Pour 1 gallon of pasteurized milk into an Instant Pot. 2 Select (“Sauté”) program and set time to 30 minutes. 3 While you are heating the milk you can stir it occasionally. Heat the milk to 86F. 4 Cancel (“Sauté”) program. 5 Sprinkle 4 packets of Buttermilk culture (C21) over the milk. 6 Let re-hydrate for 2 minutes, then stir to dissolve. 7 Close the lid, select “Yogurt” program and set time to 24 hours. 8 Let set undisturbed at 72F for preset time or until thickened. 9 Refrigerate and enjoy. 10 In addition, to make buttermilk thicker you can pour 1/4 cup dry milk.

About

 






Prep Time
0H15mins





Cook Time
24H00mins




Total Time
24H15mins





There is one category of products that we missed so far. I am referring to the drinks and beverages. However, today we are going to fix it and will show you how to make buttermilk in Instant Pot. Absolutely, this Instant Pot recipe is one of the latest and most pleasant findings.
Instant Pot will help you finalize the product in 12-24 hours. No surprise, the longer you prepare it, the thicker it becomes. The standard settings are 24 hours. Just follow the instructions and you will be pleasantly amazed by light and thick result.
You have already heard that we are focusing on the best recipes for busy families. Keep experimenting and disrupting the kitchen environment. Your limit is the sky, so transform regular recipes into Instant Pot recipes i.e. healthy, yummy and easy meals.
Here is a video recipe: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ME4E-EL7dMk
Equipment

Instant Pot DUO80 8 Qt 7-in-1 Multi- Use Programmable Pressure Cooker, Slow Cooker, Rice Cooker, Steamer, Sauté, Yogurt Maker and Warmer

Make your choice based on the budget, number of family members, kitchen size and other relevant considerations.
Here is a quick tip to consider when selecting the size of Instant Pot:
3Qt size - good for 2 people
	6Qt size - good for 3-4 people
	8Qt size - good for 5-6 people

Tel-Tru 12″ Stainless Steel Cheesemaking Thermometer 0/220 degrees F
